class NatureCNN(torchagentic.BaseAgentModel): 
 98class NatureCNN(BaseAgentModel):
 99    """
100    CNN architecture from the Nature DQN paper.
101    
102    Reference: Mnih et al., "Human-level control through deep reinforcement learning", Nature 2015.
103    
104    Architecture:
105        Conv(32, 8x8, stride=4) -> ReLU
106        Conv(64, 4x4, stride=2) -> ReLU
107        Conv(64, 3x3, stride=1) -> ReLU
108        FC(512) -> ReLU
109    """
110    
111    def __init__(
112        self,
113        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
114        image_shape: Tuple[int, int, int] = (4, 84, 84),  # Grayscale stacked frames
115    ):
116        super().__init__(config)
117        
118        self.image_shape = image_shape
119        self.channels, self.height, self.width = image_shape
120        
121        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(self.channels, 32, kernel_size=8, stride=4)
122        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(32, 64, kernel_size=4, stride=2)
123        self.conv3 = nn.Conv2d(64, 64, kernel_size=3, stride=1)
124        
125        # Compute flat dimension
126        self._feature_size = self._get_conv_output_size()
127        
128        self.fc = nn.Linear(self._feature_size, 512)
129        
130        # Output heads
131        self.action_head = nn.Linear(512, config.action_dim)
132        self.value_head = nn.Linear(512, 1)
133        
134        # Initialize
135        orthogonal_init_(self.action_head)
136        orthogonal_init_(self.value_head)
137    
138    def _get_conv_output_size(self) -> int:
139        """Calculate output size of conv layers."""
140        with torch.no_grad():
141            x = torch.zeros(1, *self.image_shape)
142            x = F.relu(self.conv1(x))
143            x = F.relu(self.conv2(x))
144            x = F.relu(self.conv3(x))
145            return x.view(1, -1).shape[1]
146    
147    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
148        """Forward through network."""
149        if x.dim() == 3:
150            x = x.transpose(1, 3)
151        
152        x = F.relu(self.conv1(x))
153        x = F.relu(self.conv2(x))
154        x = F.relu(self.conv3(x))
155        x = x.view(x.size(0), -1)
156        x = F.relu(self.fc(x))
157        return x
158    
159    def get_action(
160        self,
161        observation: torch.Tensor,
162        deterministic: bool = False,
163    ) -> torch.Tensor:
164        """Get action."""
165        features = self.forward(observation)
166        q_values = self.action_head(features)
167        
168        if deterministic:
169            return torch.argmax(q_values, dim=-1)
170        else:
171            return torch.argmax(q_values, dim=-1)  # Epsilon-greedy handled externally
172    
173    def get_q_values(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
174        """Get Q-values for all actions."""
175        features = self.forward(observation)
176        return self.action_head(features)
177    
178    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
179        """Get value estimate (max Q-value)."""
180        q_values = self.get_q_values(observation)
181        return torch.max(q_values, dim=-1).values

CNN architecture from the Nature DQN paper.

Reference: Mnih et al., "Human-level control through deep reinforcement learning", Nature 2015.

Architecture: Conv(32, 8x8, stride=4) -> ReLU Conv(64, 4x4, stride=2) -> ReLU Conv(64, 3x3, stride=1) -> ReLU FC(512) -> ReLU

NatureCNN( config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None, image_shape: Tuple[int, int, int] = (4, 84, 84))

202class ResNetNetwork(BaseAgentModel):
203    """
204    ResNet-based CNN for visual agents.
205    
206    Uses residual blocks for deeper networks with better gradient flow.
207    
208    Args:
209        config: Model configuration
210        image_shape: Input image shape
211        num_blocks: Number of residual blocks
212        base_channels: Base number of channels
213    """
214    
215    def __init__(
216        self,
217        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
218        image_shape: Tuple[int, int, int] = (3, 84, 84),
219        num_blocks: int = 3,
220        base_channels: int = 32,
221    ):
222        super().__init__(config)
223        
224        self.image_shape = image_shape
225        self.channels, self.height, self.width = image_shape
226        
227        # Initial conv
228        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(self.channels, base_channels, 7, stride=2, padding=3)
229        self.bn1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(base_channels)
230        
231        # Residual blocks
232        blocks = []
233        for _ in range(num_blocks):
234            blocks.append(ResidualBlock(base_channels))
235        self.res_blocks = nn.Sequential(*blocks)
236        
237        # Compute feature size
238        with torch.no_grad():
239            x = torch.zeros(1, *image_shape)
240            x = F.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
241            x = self.res_blocks(x)
242            flat_dim = x.view(1, -1).shape[1]
243        
244        self.fc = nn.Linear(flat_dim, 512)
245        
246        # Heads
247        self.action_head = nn.Linear(512, config.action_dim)
248        self.value_head = nn.Linear(512, 1)
249        
250        orthogonal_init_(self.action_head)
251        orthogonal_init_(self.value_head)
252    
253    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
254        """Forward through ResNet."""
255        if x.dim() == 3:
256            x = x.transpose(1, 3)
257        
258        x = F.relu(self.bn1(self.conv1(x)))
259        x = self.res_blocks(x)
260        x = x.view(x.size(0), -1)
261        x = F.relu(self.fc(x))
262        return x
263    
264    def get_action(
265        self,
266        observation: torch.Tensor,
267        deterministic: bool = False,
268    ) -> torch.Tensor:
269        """Get action."""
270        features = self.forward(observation)
271        logits = self.action_head(features)
272        
273        if deterministic:
274            return torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
275        else:
276            dist = torch.distributions.Categorical(logits=logits)
277            return dist.sample()
278    
279    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
280        """Get value estimate."""
281        features = self.forward(observation)
282        return self.value_head(features).squeeze(-1)

class RNNNetwork(torchagentic.BaseAgentModel): 
 18class RNNNetwork(BaseAgentModel):
 19    """
 20    RNN-based agent for sequential observations.
 21    
 22    Args:
 23        config: Model configuration
 24        rnn_type: Type of RNN ('rnn', 'lstm', 'gru')
 25        hidden_size: RNN hidden size
 26        num_layers: Number of RNN layers
 27        bidirectional: Whether to use bidirectional RNN
 28    """
 29    
 30    def __init__(
 31        self,
 32        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
 33        rnn_type: str = "lstm",
 34        hidden_size: int = 256,
 35        num_layers: int = 1,
 36        bidirectional: bool = False,
 37    ):
 38        super().__init__(config)
 39        
 40        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
 41        self.num_layers = num_layers
 42        self.bidirectional = bidirectional
 43        self.num_directions = 2 if bidirectional else 1
 44        
 45        # Input projection
 46        self.input_proj = nn.Linear(config.input_dim, hidden_size)
 47        
 48        # RNN
 49        rnn_cls = {
 50            "rnn": nn.RNN,
 51            "lstm": nn.LSTM,
 52            "gru": nn.GRU,
 53        }[rnn_type.lower()]
 54        
 55        self.rnn = rnn_cls(
 56            input_size=hidden_size,
 57            hidden_size=hidden_size,
 58            num_layers=num_layers,
 59            batch_first=True,
 60            bidirectional=bidirectional,
 61        )
 62        
 63        # Output layers
 64        rnn_output_dim = hidden_size * self.num_directions
 65        self.action_head = nn.Linear(rnn_output_dim, config.action_dim)
 66        self.value_head = nn.Linear(rnn_output_dim, 1)
 67        
 68        orthogonal_init_(self.action_head)
 69        orthogonal_init_(self.value_head)
 70        
 71        # Hidden state storage
 72        self._hidden_state: Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = None
 73    
 74    def forward(
 75        self,
 76        x: torch.Tensor,
 77        hidden_state: Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = None,
 78    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]]:
 79        """
 80        Forward through RNN.
 81        
 82        Args:
 83            x: Input tensor (batch_size, seq_len, input_dim) or (batch_size, input_dim)
 84            hidden_state: Previous hidden state
 85        
 86        Returns:
 87            Output and new hidden state
 88        """
 89        # Ensure 3D input
 90        if x.dim() == 2:
 91            x = x.unsqueeze(1)
 92        
 93        # Project input
 94        x = F.relu(self.input_proj(x))
 95        
 96        # RNN forward
 97        output, hidden = self.rnn(x, hidden_state)
 98        
 99        # Take last output
100        output = output[:, -1, :]
101        
102        return output, hidden
103    
104    def get_action(
105        self,
106        observation: torch.Tensor,
107        deterministic: bool = False,
108    ) -> torch.Tensor:
109        """Get action."""
110        output, hidden = self.forward(observation, self._hidden_state)
111        self._hidden_state = hidden
112        
113        logits = self.action_head(output)
114        
115        if deterministic:
116            return torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
117        else:
118            dist = torch.distributions.Categorical(logits=logits)
119            return dist.sample()
120    
121    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
122        """Get value estimate."""
123        output, _ = self.forward(observation, self._hidden_state)
124        return self.value_head(output).squeeze(-1)
125    
126    def reset(self) -> None:
127        """Reset hidden state."""
128        self._hidden_state = None
129    
130    def get_hidden_state(self) -> Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]]:
131        """Get current hidden state."""
132        return self._hidden_state
133    
134    def set_hidden_state(
135        self,
136        state: Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]],
137    ) -> None:
138        """Set hidden state."""
139        self._hidden_state = state

class LSTMAgent(torchagentic.BaseAgentModel): 
142class LSTMAgent(BaseAgentModel):
143    """
144    LSTM-based agent with separate actor and critic.
145    
146    Designed for PPO and other policy gradient methods
147    that need both action probabilities and value estimates.
148    
149    Args:
150        config: Model configuration
151        hidden_size: LSTM hidden size
152        num_layers: Number of LSTM layers
153    """
154    
155    def __init__(
156        self,
157        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
158        hidden_size: int = 256,
159        num_layers: int = 1,
160    ):
161        super().__init__(config)
162        
163        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
164        self.num_layers = num_layers
165        
166        # LSTM
167        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(
168            input_size=config.input_dim,
169            hidden_size=hidden_size,
170            num_layers=num_layers,
171            batch_first=True,
172        )
173        
174        # Actor-Critic heads
175        self.actor = nn.Linear(hidden_size, config.action_dim)
176        self.critic = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 1)
177        
178        orthogonal_init_(self.actor, gain=1.0)
179        orthogonal_init_(self.critic, gain=1.0)
180        
181        # Hidden state
182        self._hidden: Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = None
183    
184    def forward(
185        self,
186        x: torch.Tensor,
187        hidden: Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = None,
188    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]]:
189        """
190        Forward pass.
191        
192        Returns:
193            (actor_output, critic_output, new_hidden)
194        """
195        # Ensure 3D
196        if x.dim() == 2:
197            x = x.unsqueeze(1)
198        
199        # LSTM
200        lstm_out, hidden = self.lstm(x, hidden)
201        
202        # Take last timestep
203        out = lstm_out[:, -1, :]
204        
205        actor_out = self.actor(out)
206        critic_out = self.critic(out).squeeze(-1)
207        
208        return actor_out, critic_out, hidden
209    
210    def get_action(
211        self,
212        observation: torch.Tensor,
213        deterministic: bool = False,
214    ) -> torch.Tensor:
215        """Get action."""
216        actor_out, _, hidden = self.forward(observation, self._hidden)
217        self._hidden = hidden
218        
219        logits = actor_out
220        
221        if deterministic:
222            return torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
223        else:
224            dist = torch.distributions.Categorical(logits=logits)
225            return dist.sample()
226    
227    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
228        """Get value estimate."""
229        _, critic_out, _ = self.forward(observation, self._hidden)
230        return critic_out
231    
232    def get_action_and_value(
233        self,
234        observation: torch.Tensor,
235        deterministic: bool = False,
236    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
237        """Get action and value in single forward pass."""
238        actor_out, critic_out, hidden = self.forward(observation, self._hidden)
239        self._hidden = hidden
240        
241        logits = actor_out
242        
243        if deterministic:
244            action = torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
245        else:
246            dist = torch.distributions.Categorical(logits=logits)
247            action = dist.sample()
248        
249        return action, critic_out
250    
251    def get_log_prob(
252        self,
253        observation: torch.Tensor,
254        action: torch.Tensor,
255    ) -> torch.Tensor:
256        """Get log probability of action."""
257        actor_out, _, _ = self.forward(observation, self._hidden)
258        logits = actor_out
259        dist = torch.distributions.Categorical(logits=logits)
260        return dist.log_prob(action)
261    
262    def get_entropy(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
263        """Get entropy of action distribution."""
264        actor_out, _, _ = self.forward(observation, self._hidden)
265        logits = actor_out
266        dist = torch.distributions.Categorical(logits=logits)
267        return dist.entropy()
268    
269    def reset(self) -> None:
270        """Reset hidden state."""
271        device = next(self.parameters()).device
272        self._hidden = (
273            torch.zeros(self.num_layers, 1, self.hidden_size, device=device),
274            torch.zeros(self.num_layers, 1, self.hidden_size, device=device),
275        )
276    
277    def get_hidden_state(self) -> Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]]:
278        """Get hidden state."""
279        return self._hidden
280    
281    def set_hidden_state(
282        self,
283        state: Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]],
284    ) -> None:
285        """Set hidden state."""
286        self._hidden = state

class GRUAgent(torchagentic.BaseAgentModel): 
289class GRUAgent(BaseAgentModel):
290    """
291    GRU-based agent for sequential decision making.
292    
293    Simpler alternative to LSTM with fewer parameters.
294    
295    Args:
296        config: Model configuration
297        hidden_size: GRU hidden size
298        num_layers: Number of GRU layers
299    """
300    
301    def __init__(
302        self,
303        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
304        hidden_size: int = 256,
305        num_layers: int = 1,
306    ):
307        super().__init__(config)
308        
309        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
310        self.num_layers = num_layers
311        
312        # GRU
313        self.gru = nn.GRU(
314            input_size=config.input_dim,
315            hidden_size=hidden_size,
316            num_layers=num_layers,
317            batch_first=True,
318        )
319        
320        # Output heads
321        self.action_head = nn.Linear(hidden_size, config.action_dim)
322        self.value_head = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 1)
323        
324        orthogonal_init_(self.action_head)
325        orthogonal_init_(self.value_head)
326        
327        # Hidden state
328        self._hidden: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
329    
330    def forward(
331        self,
332        x: torch.Tensor,
333        hidden: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
334    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
335        """Forward pass."""
336        if x.dim() == 2:
337            x = x.unsqueeze(1)
338        
339        gru_out, hidden = self.gru(x, hidden)
340        out = gru_out[:, -1, :]
341        
342        return out, hidden
343    
344    def get_action(
345        self,
346        observation: torch.Tensor,
347        deterministic: bool = False,
348    ) -> torch.Tensor:
349        """Get action."""
350        out, hidden = self.forward(observation, self._hidden)
351        self._hidden = hidden
352        
353        logits = self.action_head(out)
354        
355        if deterministic:
356            return torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
357        else:
358            dist = torch.distributions.Categorical(logits=logits)
359            return dist.sample()
360    
361    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
362        """Get value estimate."""
363        out, _ = self.forward(observation, self._hidden)
364        return self.value_head(out).squeeze(-1)
365    
366    def reset(self) -> None:
367        """Reset hidden state."""
368        device = next(self.parameters()).device
369        self._hidden = torch.zeros(
370            self.num_layers, 1, self.hidden_size, device=device
371        )
372    
373    def get_hidden_state(self) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
374        """Get hidden state."""
375        return self._hidden
376    
377    def set_hidden_state(self, state: Optional[torch.Tensor]) -> None:
378        """Set hidden state."""
379        self._hidden = state

class DQN(torchagentic.BaseAgentModel): 
 21class DQN(BaseAgentModel):
 22    """
 23    Standard Deep Q-Network.
 24    
 25    Reference: Mnih et al., "Human-level control through deep reinforcement learning", Nature 2015.
 26    
 27    Args:
 28        config: Model configuration
 29        image_input: Whether input is image (CHW) or vector
 30    """
 31    
 32    def __init__(
 33        self,
 34        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
 35        image_input: bool = False,
 36    ):
 37        super().__init__(config)
 38        
 39        self.image_input = image_input
 40        
 41        if image_input:
 42            # CNN backbone for image input
 43            self.backbone = nn.Sequential(
 44                nn.Conv2d(config.input_dim, 32, 8, stride=4),
 45                nn.ReLU(),
 46                nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 4, stride=2),
 47                nn.ReLU(),
 48                nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, stride=1),
 49                nn.ReLU(),
 50            )
 51            
 52            # Calculate flat dim
 53            with torch.no_grad():
 54                dummy = torch.zeros(1, config.input_dim, 84, 84)
 55                flat_dim = self.backbone(dummy).view(1, -1).shape[1]
 56        else:
 57            # MLP backbone for vector input
 58            layers = []
 59            prev_dim = config.input_dim
 60            for hidden_dim in config.hidden_dims:
 61                layers.append(nn.Linear(prev_dim, hidden_dim))
 62                layers.append(nn.ReLU())
 63                prev_dim = hidden_dim
 64            self.backbone = nn.Sequential(*layers)
 65            flat_dim = config.hidden_dims[-1]
 66        
 67        # Q-value head
 68        self.q_head = nn.Linear(flat_dim, config.action_dim)
 69        orthogonal_init_(self.q_head)
 70    
 71    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 72        """Forward pass returning Q-values."""
 73        if self.image_input and x.dim() == 3:
 74            x = x.transpose(1, 3)
 75        
 76        features = self.backbone(x)
 77        features = features.view(features.size(0), -1)
 78        return self.q_head(features)
 79    
 80    def get_q_values(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 81        """Get Q-values for all actions."""
 82        return self.forward(observation)
 83    
 84    def get_action(
 85        self,
 86        observation: torch.Tensor,
 87        deterministic: bool = False,
 88        epsilon: float = 0.0,
 89    ) -> torch.Tensor:
 90        """
 91        Get action using epsilon-greedy policy.
 92        
 93        Args:
 94            observation: Current observation
 95            deterministic: If True, ignore epsilon and take argmax
 96            epsilon: Exploration rate for epsilon-greedy
 97        """
 98        q_values = self.get_q_values(observation)
 99        
100        if deterministic:
101            return torch.argmax(q_values, dim=-1)
102        
103        # Epsilon-greedy
104        batch_size = q_values.shape[0]
105        random_actions = torch.randint(
106            0, self.config.action_dim, (batch_size,),
107            device=q_values.device,
108        )
109        greedy_actions = torch.argmax(q_values, dim=-1)
110        
111        # Random mask
112        random_mask = torch.rand(batch_size, device=q_values.device) < epsilon
113        return torch.where(random_mask, random_actions, greedy_actions)
114    
115    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
116        """Get value (max Q-value)."""
117        q_values = self.get_q_values(observation)
118        return torch.max(q_values, dim=-1).values

Reference: Mnih et al., "Human-level control through deep reinforcement learning", Nature 2015.

class DuelingDQN(torchagentic.BaseAgentModel): 
121class DuelingDQN(BaseAgentModel):
122    """
123    Dueling DQN architecture.
124    
125    Separates value and advantage streams for better Q-value estimation.
126    
127    Reference: Wang et al., "Dueling Network Architectures for Deep Reinforcement Learning", ICML 2016.
128    
129    Args:
130        config: Model configuration
131        image_input: Whether input is image
132    """
133    
134    def __init__(
135        self,
136        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
137        image_input: bool = False,
138    ):
139        super().__init__(config)
140        
141        self.image_input = image_input
142        
143        if image_input:
144            self.backbone = nn.Sequential(
145                nn.Conv2d(config.input_dim, 32, 8, stride=4),
146                nn.ReLU(),
147                nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 4, stride=2),
148                nn.ReLU(),
149                nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, stride=1),
150                nn.ReLU(),
151            )
152            
153            with torch.no_grad():
154                dummy = torch.zeros(1, config.input_dim, 84, 84)
155                flat_dim = self.backbone(dummy).view(1, -1).shape[1]
156        else:
157            layers = []
158            prev_dim = config.input_dim
159            for hidden_dim in config.hidden_dims:
160                layers.append(nn.Linear(prev_dim, hidden_dim))
161                layers.append(nn.ReLU())
162                prev_dim = hidden_dim
163            self.backbone = nn.Sequential(*layers)
164            flat_dim = config.hidden_dims[-1]
165        
166        # Value stream
167        self.value_stream = nn.Sequential(
168            nn.Linear(flat_dim, flat_dim // 2),
169            nn.ReLU(),
170            nn.Linear(flat_dim // 2, 1),
171        )
172        
173        # Advantage stream
174        self.advantage_stream = nn.Sequential(
175            nn.Linear(flat_dim, flat_dim // 2),
176            nn.ReLU(),
177            nn.Linear(flat_dim // 2, config.action_dim),
178        )
179        
180        orthogonal_init_(self.value_stream[-1])
181        orthogonal_init_(self.advantage_stream[-1])
182    
183    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
184        """Forward pass returning Q-values."""
185        if self.image_input and x.dim() == 3:
186            x = x.transpose(1, 3)
187        
188        features = self.backbone(x)
189        features = features.view(features.size(0), -1)
190        
191        # Value and advantage
192        value = self.value_stream(features)  # (B, 1)
193        advantage = self.advantage_stream(features)  # (B, A)
194        
195        # Combine: Q = V + (A - mean(A))
196        q_values = value + (advantage - advantage.mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True))
197        
198        return q_values
199    
200    def get_q_values(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
201        """Get Q-values."""
202        return self.forward(observation)
203    
204    def get_action(
205        self,
206        observation: torch.Tensor,
207        deterministic: bool = False,
208        epsilon: float = 0.0,
209    ) -> torch.Tensor:
210        """Get action."""
211        q_values = self.get_q_values(observation)
212        
213        if deterministic:
214            return torch.argmax(q_values, dim=-1)
215        
216        batch_size = q_values.shape[0]
217        random_actions = torch.randint(
218            0, self.config.action_dim, (batch_size,),
219            device=q_values.device,
220        )
221        greedy_actions = torch.argmax(q_values, dim=-1)
222        
223        random_mask = torch.rand(batch_size, device=q_values.device) < epsilon
224        return torch.where(random_mask, random_actions, greedy_actions)
225    
226    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
227        """Get value estimate."""
228        if self.image_input and observation.dim() == 3:
229            obs = observation.transpose(1, 3)
230        else:
231            obs = observation
232        
233        features = self.backbone(obs).view(observation.size(0), -1)
234        return self.value_stream(features).squeeze(-1)

class NoisyDQN(torchagentic.BaseAgentModel): 
297class NoisyDQN(BaseAgentModel):
298    """
299    DQN with Noisy Networks for exploration.
300    
301    Uses parameterized noise instead of epsilon-greedy for exploration.
302    
303    Reference: Fortunato et al., "Noisy Networks for Exploration", ICLR 2018.
304    
305    Args:
306        config: Model configuration
307        image_input: Whether input is image
308        sigma0: Initial noise standard deviation
309    """
310    
311    def __init__(
312        self,
313        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
314        image_input: bool = False,
315        sigma0: float = 0.5,
316    ):
317        super().__init__(config)
318        
319        self.image_input = image_input
320        
321        if image_input:
322            self.backbone = nn.Sequential(
323                nn.Conv2d(config.input_dim, 32, 8, stride=4),
324                nn.ReLU(),
325                nn.Conv2d(32, 64, 4, stride=2),
326                nn.ReLU(),
327                nn.Conv2d(64, 64, 3, stride=1),
328                nn.ReLU(),
329            )
330            
331            with torch.no_grad():
332                dummy = torch.zeros(1, config.input_dim, 84, 84)
333                flat_dim = self.backbone(dummy).view(1, -1).shape[1]
334        else:
335            layers = []
336            prev_dim = config.input_dim
337            for hidden_dim in config.hidden_dims:
338                layers.append(nn.Linear(prev_dim, hidden_dim))
339                layers.append(nn.ReLU())
340                prev_dim = hidden_dim
341            self.backbone = nn.Sequential(*layers)
342            flat_dim = config.hidden_dims[-1]
343        
344        # Noisy linear layer
345        self.q_head = NoisyLinear(flat_dim, config.action_dim, sigma0=sigma0)
346    
347    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
348        """Forward pass."""
349        if self.image_input and x.dim() == 3:
350            x = x.transpose(1, 3)
351        
352        features = self.backbone(x)
353        features = features.view(features.size(0), -1)
354        return self.q_head(features)
355    
356    def get_q_values(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
357        """Get Q-values."""
358        return self.forward(observation)
359    
360    def get_action(
361        self,
362        observation: torch.Tensor,
363        deterministic: bool = False,
364    ) -> torch.Tensor:
365        """
366        Get action.
367        
368        In training mode, noise is automatically added.
369        In eval mode, use deterministic=True for greedy actions.
370        """
371        training = self.training
372        
373        if deterministic:
374            self.eval()
375        
376        with torch.no_grad():
377            q_values = self.get_q_values(observation)
378            action = torch.argmax(q_values, dim=-1)
379        
380        if training:
381            self.train()
382        
383        return action
384    
385    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
386        """Get value (max Q-value)."""
387        q_values = self.get_q_values(observation)
388        return torch.max(q_values, dim=-1).values
389    
390    def reset_noise(self) -> None:
391        """Reset noise in noisy layers (called at each episode)."""
392        # Noise is automatically sampled in forward pass during training
393        pass

class PPOActor(torchagentic.BaseAgentModel): 
 18class PPOActor(BaseAgentModel):
 19    """
 20    Actor network for PPO.
 21    
 22    Outputs action probabilities for discrete actions or
 23    mean/std for continuous actions.
 24    
 25    Args:
 26        config: Model configuration
 27        continuous: Whether action space is continuous
 28    """
 29    
 30    def __init__(
 31        self,
 32        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
 33        continuous: bool = False,
 34    ):
 35        super().__init__(config)
 36        self.continuous = continuous
 37        
 38        # Backbone
 39        layers = []
 40        prev_dim = config.input_dim
 41        for hidden_dim in config.hidden_dims:
 42            layers.append(nn.Linear(prev_dim, hidden_dim))
 43            layers.append(nn.Tanh())
 44            prev_dim = hidden_dim
 45        self.backbone = nn.Sequential(*layers)
 46        last_dim = config.hidden_dims[-1]
 47        
 48        if continuous:
 49            # Mean and log-std for continuous actions
 50            self.action_mean = nn.Linear(last_dim, config.action_dim)
 51            self.action_logstd = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(config.action_dim))
 52            orthogonal_init_(self.action_mean, gain=0.01)
 53        else:
 54            # Logits for discrete actions
 55            self.action_head = nn.Linear(last_dim, config.action_dim)
 56            orthogonal_init_(self.action_head, gain=1.0)
 57    
 58    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
 59        """Forward through backbone."""
 60        return self.backbone(x)
 61    
 62    def get_distribution(self, observation: torch.Tensor):
 63        """Get action distribution."""
 64        features = self.forward(observation)
 65        
 66        if self.continuous:
 67            mean = self.action_mean(features)
 68            std = self.action_logstd.exp().expand_as(mean)
 69            return dist.Normal(mean, std)
 70        else:
 71            logits = self.action_head(features)
 72            return dist.Categorical(logits=logits)
 73    
 74    def get_action(
 75        self,
 76        observation: torch.Tensor,
 77        deterministic: bool = False,
 78    ) -> torch.Tensor:
 79        """Get action."""
 80        if deterministic:
 81            if self.continuous:
 82                features = self.forward(observation)
 83                return self.action_mean(features)
 84            else:
 85                features = self.forward(observation)
 86                logits = self.action_head(features)
 87                return torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
 88        else:
 89            d = self.get_distribution(observation)
 90            return d.sample()
 91    
 92    def get_log_prob(
 93        self,
 94        observation: torch.Tensor,
 95        action: torch.Tensor,
 96    ) -> torch.Tensor:
 97        """Get log probability of action."""
 98        d = self.get_distribution(observation)
 99        return d.log_prob(action).sum(dim=-1) if self.continuous else d.log_prob(action)
100    
101    def get_entropy(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
102        """Get entropy of action distribution."""
103        d = self.get_distribution(observation)
104        return d.entropy().sum(dim=-1) if self.continuous else d.entropy()
105    
106    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
107        """Dummy value method (not used in actor-only)."""
108        raise NotImplementedError("Use PPOActorCritic for value estimation")

149class PPOActorCritic(BaseAgentModel):
150    """
151    Combined Actor-Critic network for PPO.
152    
153    Shares backbone between actor and critic for efficiency.
154    
155    Args:
156        config: Model configuration
157        continuous: Whether action space is continuous
158    """
159    
160    def __init__(
161        self,
162        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
163        continuous: bool = False,
164    ):
165        super().__init__(config)
166        self.continuous = continuous
167        
168        # Shared backbone
169        layers = []
170        prev_dim = config.input_dim
171        for hidden_dim in config.hidden_dims:
172            layers.append(nn.Linear(prev_dim, hidden_dim))
173            layers.append(nn.Tanh())
174            prev_dim = hidden_dim
175        self.backbone = nn.Sequential(*layers)
176        last_dim = config.hidden_dims[-1]
177        
178        # Actor head
179        if continuous:
180            self.action_mean = nn.Linear(last_dim, config.action_dim)
181            self.action_logstd = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(config.action_dim))
182            orthogonal_init_(self.action_mean, gain=0.01)
183        else:
184            self.action_head = nn.Linear(last_dim, config.action_dim)
185            orthogonal_init_(self.action_head, gain=1.0)
186        
187        # Critic head
188        self.critic_head = nn.Linear(last_dim, 1)
189        orthogonal_init_(self.critic_head, gain=1.0)
190    
191    def forward(
192        self,
193        x: torch.Tensor,
194    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
195        """
196        Forward pass.
197        
198        Returns:
199            (action_output, value)
200        """
201        features = self.backbone(x)
202        
203        if self.continuous:
204            action_out = self.action_mean(features)
205        else:
206            action_out = self.action_head(features)
207        
208        value = self.critic_head(features).squeeze(-1)
209        
210        return action_out, value
211    
212    def get_distribution(self, observation: torch.Tensor):
213        """Get action distribution."""
214        features = self.backbone(observation)
215        
216        if self.continuous:
217            mean = self.action_mean(features)
218            std = self.action_logstd.exp().expand_as(mean)
219            return dist.Normal(mean, std)
220        else:
221            logits = self.action_head(features)
222            return dist.Categorical(logits=logits)
223    
224    def get_action(
225        self,
226        observation: torch.Tensor,
227        deterministic: bool = False,
228    ) -> torch.Tensor:
229        """Get action."""
230        if deterministic:
231            if self.continuous:
232                features = self.backbone(observation)
233                return self.action_mean(features)
234            else:
235                features = self.backbone(observation)
236                logits = self.action_head(features)
237                return torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
238        else:
239            d = self.get_distribution(observation)
240            return d.sample()
241    
242    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
243        """Get value estimate."""
244        features = self.backbone(observation)
245        return self.critic_head(features).squeeze(-1)
246    
247    def get_action_and_value(
248        self,
249        observation: torch.Tensor,
250        action: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
251        deterministic: bool = False,
252    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
253        """
254        Get action, log_prob, entropy, and value in single forward pass.
255        
256        Returns:
257            (action, log_prob, entropy, value)
258        """
259        features = self.backbone(observation)
260        
261        # Get distribution
262        if self.continuous:
263            mean = self.action_mean(features)
264            std = self.action_logstd.exp().expand_as(mean)
265            d = dist.Normal(mean, std)
266        else:
267            logits = self.action_head(features)
268            d = dist.Categorical(logits=logits)
269        
270        # Sample or use provided action
271        if action is None:
272            if deterministic:
273                action = d.mean if self.continuous else torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
274            else:
275                action = d.sample()
276        
277        log_prob = d.log_prob(action)
278        if self.continuous:
279            log_prob = log_prob.sum(dim=-1)
280        entropy = d.entropy()
281        if self.continuous:
282            entropy = entropy.sum(dim=-1)
283        
284        value = self.critic_head(features).squeeze(-1)
285        
286        return action, log_prob, entropy, value
287    
288    def evaluate_actions(
289        self,
290        observation: torch.Tensor,
291        action: torch.Tensor,
292    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
293        """
294        Evaluate actions (for PPO update).
295        
296        Returns:
297            (log_prob, entropy, value)
298        """
299        features = self.backbone(observation)
300        
301        if self.continuous:
302            mean = self.action_mean(features)
303            std = self.action_logstd.exp().expand_as(mean)
304            d = dist.Normal(mean, std)
305            log_prob = d.log_prob(action).sum(dim=-1)
306        else:
307            logits = self.action_head(features)
308            d = dist.Categorical(logits=logits)
309            log_prob = d.log_prob(action)
310        
311        entropy = d.entropy()
312        if self.continuous:
313            entropy = entropy.sum(dim=-1)
314        
315        value = self.critic_head(features).squeeze(-1)
316        
317        return log_prob, entropy, value

class A3CNetwork(torchagentic.BaseAgentModel): 
 18class A3CNetwork(BaseAgentModel):
 19    """
 20    A3C network with shared trunk and separate actor/critic heads.
 21    
 22    Reference: Mnih et al., "Asynchronous Methods for Deep Reinforcement Learning", ICML 2016.
 23    
 24    Args:
 25        config: Model configuration
 26        image_input: Whether input is image
 27        use_lstm: Whether to add LSTM layer
 28        lstm_hidden: LSTM hidden size
 29    """
 30    
 31    def __init__(
 32        self,
 33        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
 34        image_input: bool = False,
 35        use_lstm: bool = False,
 36        lstm_hidden: int = 256,
 37    ):
 38        super().__init__(config)
 39        
 40        self.image_input = image_input
 41        self.use_lstm = use_lstm
 42        
 43        if image_input:
 44            # CNN trunk (Nature-style)
 45            self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(config.input_dim, 16, 8, stride=4)
 46            self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(16, 32, 4, stride=2)
 47            
 48            # Calculate flat dim
 49            with torch.no_grad():
 50                dummy = torch.zeros(1, config.input_dim, 84, 84)
 51                x = F.relu(self.conv1(dummy))
 52                x = F.relu(self.conv2(x))
 53                flat_dim = x.view(1, -1).shape[1]
 54        else:
 55            # MLP trunk
 56            self.fc1 = nn.Linear(config.input_dim, config.hidden_dims[0])
 57            flat_dim = config.hidden_dims[0]
 58        
 59        # LSTM (optional)
 60        if use_lstm:
 61            self.lstm = nn.LSTM(flat_dim, lstm_hidden, batch_first=True)
 62            trunk_output_dim = lstm_hidden
 63        else:
 64            self.lstm = None
 65            trunk_output_dim = flat_dim
 66        
 67        # Actor head
 68        self.actor = nn.Linear(trunk_output_dim, config.action_dim)
 69        orthogonal_init_(self.actor, gain=0.01)
 70        
 71        # Critic head
 72        self.critic = nn.Linear(trunk_output_dim, 1)
 73        orthogonal_init_(self.critic, gain=1.0)
 74        
 75        # Hidden state for LSTM
 76        self._hidden: Optional[tuple] = None
 77    
 78    def forward(
 79        self,
 80        x: torch.Tensor,
 81        hidden: Optional[tuple] = None,
 82    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, tuple]:
 83        """
 84        Forward pass.
 85        
 86        Args:
 87            x: Input tensor
 88            hidden: LSTM hidden state (if using LSTM)
 89        
 90        Returns:
 91            (actor_logits, value, new_hidden)
 92        """
 93        if self.image_input:
 94            if x.dim() == 3:
 95                x = x.transpose(1, 3)
 96            x = F.relu(self.conv1(x))
 97            x = F.relu(self.conv2(x))
 98            x = x.view(x.size(0), -1)
 99        else:
100            x = F.relu(self.fc1(x))
101        
102        # LSTM
103        if self.use_lstm:
104            if x.dim() == 2:
105                x = x.unsqueeze(1)
106            x, hidden = self.lstm(x, hidden)
107            x = x[:, -1, :]
108        
109        # Heads
110        actor_logits = self.actor(x)
111        value = self.critic(x).squeeze(-1)
112        
113        return actor_logits, value, hidden
114    
115    def get_action(
116        self,
117        observation: torch.Tensor,
118        deterministic: bool = False,
119    ) -> torch.Tensor:
120        """Get action."""
121        logits, _, hidden = self.forward(observation, self._hidden)
122        self._hidden = hidden
123        
124        if deterministic:
125            return torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
126        else:
127            d = dist.Categorical(logits=logits)
128            return d.sample()
129    
130    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
131        """Get value estimate."""
132        _, value, _ = self.forward(observation, self._hidden)
133        return value
134    
135    def get_action_and_value(
136        self,
137        observation: torch.Tensor,
138        action: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
139        deterministic: bool = False,
140    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
141        """
142        Get action, log_prob, entropy, and value.
143        
144        Returns:
145            (action, log_prob, entropy, value)
146        """
147        logits, value, hidden = self.forward(observation, self._hidden)
148        self._hidden = hidden
149        
150        d = dist.Categorical(logits=logits)
151        
152        if action is None:
153            if deterministic:
154                action = torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
155            else:
156                action = d.sample()
157        
158        log_prob = d.log_prob(action)
159        entropy = d.entropy()
160        
161        return action, log_prob, entropy, value
162    
163    def evaluate_actions(
164        self,
165        observation: torch.Tensor,
166        action: torch.Tensor,
167    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
168        """
169        Evaluate actions.
170        
171        Returns:
172            (log_prob, entropy, value)
173        """
174        logits, value, _ = self.forward(observation, self._hidden)
175        d = dist.Categorical(logits=logits)
176        
177        log_prob = d.log_prob(action)
178        entropy = d.entropy()
179        
180        return log_prob, entropy, value
181    
182    def reset(self) -> None:
183        """Reset LSTM hidden state."""
184        if self.use_lstm:
185            device = next(self.parameters()).device
186            self._hidden = (
187                torch.zeros(1, 1, self.lstm.hidden_size, device=device),
188                torch.zeros(1, 1, self.lstm.hidden_size, device=device),
189            )
190    
191    def get_hidden_state(self) -> Optional[tuple]:
192        """Get LSTM hidden state."""
193        return self._hidden
194    
195    def set_hidden_state(self, state: Optional[tuple]) -> None:
196        """Set LSTM hidden state."""
197        self._hidden = state

class SACActor(torchagentic.BaseAgentModel): 
 22class SACActor(BaseAgentModel):
 23    """
 24    Stochastic actor for SAC.
 25    
 26    Outputs a Gaussian distribution over continuous actions.
 27    Uses squashed Gaussian for bounded action spaces.
 28    
 29    Reference: Haarnoja et al., "Soft Actor-Critic: Off-Policy Maximum Entropy Deep RL", ICML 2018.
 30    
 31    Args:
 32        config: Model configuration
 33        action_bounds: Tuple of (min, max) action values
 34    """
 35    
 36    def __init__(
 37        self,
 38        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
 39        action_bounds: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = None,
 40    ):
 41        super().__init__(config)
 42        
 43        self.action_bounds = action_bounds or (-1.0, 1.0)
 44        
 45        # Backbone
 46        layers = []
 47        prev_dim = config.input_dim
 48        for hidden_dim in config.hidden_dims:
 49            layers.append(nn.Linear(prev_dim, hidden_dim))
 50            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
 51            prev_dim = hidden_dim
 52        self.backbone = nn.Sequential(*layers)
 53        last_dim = config.hidden_dims[-1]
 54        
 55        # Mean and log-std heads
 56        self.mean_head = nn.Linear(last_dim, config.action_dim)
 57        self.logstd_head = nn.Linear(last_dim, config.action_dim)
 58        
 59        orthogonal_init_(self.mean_head, gain=0.01)
 60        orthogonal_init_(self.logstd_head, gain=0.01)
 61    
 62    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
 63        """
 64        Forward pass.
 65        
 66        Returns:
 67            (mean, log_std)
 68        """
 69        features = self.backbone(x)
 70        mean = self.mean_head(features)
 71        log_std = self.logstd_head(features)
 72        log_std = torch.clamp(log_std, LOG_STD_MIN, LOG_STD_MAX)
 73        return mean, log_std
 74    
 75    def get_distribution(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> dist.TransformedDistribution:
 76        """
 77        Get squashed Gaussian distribution.
 78        
 79        Returns:
 80            TransformedDistribution (squashed Gaussian)
 81        """
 82        mean, log_std = self.forward(observation)
 83        std = log_std.exp()
 84        
 85        base_dist = dist.Normal(mean, std)
 86        
 87        # Squash with tanh
 88        return dist.TransformedDistribution(
 89            base_dist,
 90            [dist.transforms.TanhTransform(cache_size=1)],
 91        )
 92    
 93    def get_action(
 94        self,
 95        observation: torch.Tensor,
 96        deterministic: bool = False,
 97        with_log_prob: bool = False,
 98    ) -> torch.Tensor | Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
 99        """
100        Get action.
101        
102        Args:
103            observation: Current observation
104            deterministic: Use mean action
105            with_log_prob: Also return log probability
106        
107        Returns:
108            action, (log_prob if with_log_prob)
109        """
110        if deterministic:
111            mean, _ = self.forward(observation)
112            action = torch.tanh(mean)
113            
114            # Scale to action bounds
115            low, high = self.action_bounds
116            action = action * (high - low) / 2 + (high + low) / 2
117            
118            if with_log_prob:
119                return action, torch.zeros(observation.size(0), device=observation.device)
120            return action
121        
122        dist = self.get_distribution(observation)
123        action = dist.rsample()  # Reparameterized sample
124        log_prob = dist.log_prob(action).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
125        
126        # Scale to action bounds
127        low, high = self.action_bounds
128        action = action * (high - low) / 2 + (high + low) / 2
129        
130        if with_log_prob:
131            return action, log_prob
132        return action
133    
134    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
135        """Not applicable for actor."""
136        raise NotImplementedError("Actor does not estimate value")

 93    def get_action(
 94        self,
 95        observation: torch.Tensor,
 96        deterministic: bool = False,
 97        with_log_prob: bool = False,
 98    ) -> torch.Tensor | Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
 99        """
100        Get action.
101        
102        Args:
103            observation: Current observation
104            deterministic: Use mean action
105            with_log_prob: Also return log probability
106        
107        Returns:
108            action, (log_prob if with_log_prob)
109        """
110        if deterministic:
111            mean, _ = self.forward(observation)
112            action = torch.tanh(mean)
113            
114            # Scale to action bounds
115            low, high = self.action_bounds
116            action = action * (high - low) / 2 + (high + low) / 2
117            
118            if with_log_prob:
119                return action, torch.zeros(observation.size(0), device=observation.device)
120            return action
121        
122        dist = self.get_distribution(observation)
123        action = dist.rsample()  # Reparameterized sample
124        log_prob = dist.log_prob(action).sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
125        
126        # Scale to action bounds
127        low, high = self.action_bounds
128        action = action * (high - low) / 2 + (high + low) / 2
129        
130        if with_log_prob:
131            return action, log_prob
132        return action

class TD3Actor(torchagentic.BaseAgentModel): 
17class TD3Actor(BaseAgentModel):
18    """
19    Deterministic actor for TD3.
20    
21    Reference: Fujimoto et al., "Addressing Function Approximation Error in Actor-Critic Methods", ICML 2018.
22    
23    Args:
24        config: Model configuration
25        action_bounds: Tuple of (min, max) action values
26    """
27    
28    def __init__(
29        self,
30        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
31        action_bounds: Optional[Tuple[float, float]] = None,
32    ):
33        super().__init__(config)
34        
35        self.action_bounds = action_bounds or (-1.0, 1.0)
36        
37        # Backbone
38        layers = []
39        prev_dim = config.input_dim
40        for hidden_dim in config.hidden_dims:
41            layers.append(nn.Linear(prev_dim, hidden_dim))
42            layers.append(nn.ReLU())
43            prev_dim = hidden_dim
44        self.backbone = nn.Sequential(*layers)
45        last_dim = config.hidden_dims[-1]
46        
47        # Action head with tanh
48        self.action_head = nn.Linear(last_dim, config.action_dim)
49        nn.init.uniform_(self.action_head.weight, -3e-3, 3e-3)
50        nn.init.uniform_(self.action_head.bias, -3e-3, 3e-3)
51    
52    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
53        """Forward pass."""
54        features = self.backbone(x)
55        return torch.tanh(self.action_head(features))
56    
57    def get_action(
58        self,
59        observation: torch.Tensor,
60        deterministic: bool = True,
61        noise: Optional[float] = None,
62    ) -> torch.Tensor:
63        """
64        Get action.
65        
66        Args:
67            observation: Current observation
68            deterministic: Use deterministic action
69            noise: Optional noise to add for exploration
70        """
71        action = self.forward(observation)
72        
73        # Add noise if specified
74        if noise is not None:
75            action = action + torch.randn_like(action) * noise
76            action = torch.clamp(action, -1, 1)
77        
78        # Scale to action bounds
79        low, high = self.action_bounds
80        action = action * (high - low) / 2 + (high + low) / 2
81        
82        return action
83    
84    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
85        """Not applicable."""
86        raise NotImplementedError("Actor does not estimate value")

Deterministic actor for TD3.

Reference: Fujimoto et al., "Addressing Function Approximation Error in Actor-Critic Methods", ICML 2018.

class TransformerAgent(torchagentic.BaseAgentModel): 
 18class TransformerAgent(BaseAgentModel):
 19    """
 20    Transformer-based agent for sequential decision making.
 21    
 22    Uses self-attention to process sequences of observations.
 23    
 24    Args:
 25        config: Model configuration
 26        embed_dim: Embedding dimension
 27        num_heads: Number of attention heads
 28        num_layers: Number of transformer layers
 29        max_seq_len: Maximum sequence length
 30        dropout: Dropout probability
 31    """
 32    
 33    def __init__(
 34        self,
 35        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
 36        embed_dim: int = 256,
 37        num_heads: int = 8,
 38        num_layers: int = 4,
 39        max_seq_len: int = 1024,
 40        dropout: float = 0.1,
 41    ):
 42        super().__init__(config)
 43        
 44        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
 45        self.max_seq_len = max_seq_len
 46        
 47        # Input embedding
 48        self.input_embed = nn.Linear(config.input_dim, embed_dim)
 49        
 50        # Positional encoding
 51        self.pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, max_seq_len, embed_dim))
 52        
 53        # Transformer layers
 54        self.transformer_blocks = nn.ModuleList([
 55            TransformerBlock(embed_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout)
 56            for _ in range(num_layers)
 57        ])
 58        
 59        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)
 60        
 61        # Output heads
 62        self.action_head = nn.Linear(embed_dim, config.action_dim)
 63        self.value_head = nn.Linear(embed_dim, 1)
 64        
 65        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
 66        
 67        # Initialize
 68        nn.init.normal_(self.pos_embed, std=0.02)
 69        self._init_weights()
 70    
 71    def _init_weights(self):
 72        """Initialize weights."""
 73        for module in self.modules():
 74            if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
 75                nn.init.normal_(module.weight, std=0.02)
 76                if module.bias is not None:
 77                    nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
 78            elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
 79                nn.init.ones_(module.weight)
 80                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
 81    
 82    def forward(
 83        self,
 84        x: torch.Tensor,
 85        mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
 86    ) -> torch.Tensor:
 87        """
 88        Forward pass.
 89        
 90        Args:
 91            x: Input tensor (batch, seq_len, input_dim)
 92            mask: Optional attention mask
 93        
 94        Returns:
 95            Output tensor (batch, seq_len, embed_dim)
 96        """
 97        B, T, _ = x.shape
 98        
 99        # Embed input
100        x = self.input_embed(x)
101        
102        # Add positional encoding
103        x = x + self.pos_embed[:, :T, :]
104        x = self.dropout(x)
105        
106        # Create causal mask if not provided
107        if mask is None:
108            mask = torch.tril(torch.ones(T, T, device=x.device)).view(1, 1, T, T)
109        
110        # Transformer blocks
111        for block in self.transformer_blocks:
112            x = block(x, mask)
113        
114        return self.ln(x)
115    
116    def get_action(
117        self,
118        observation: torch.Tensor,
119        deterministic: bool = False,
120    ) -> torch.Tensor:
121        """Get action."""
122        # Ensure 3D
123        if observation.dim() == 2:
124            observation = observation.unsqueeze(1)
125        
126        features = self.forward(observation)
127        
128        # Use last token
129        features = features[:, -1, :]
130        
131        logits = self.action_head(features)
132        
133        if deterministic:
134            return torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
135        else:
136            dist = torch.distributions.Categorical(logits=logits)
137            return dist.sample()
138    
139    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
140        """Get value estimate."""
141        if observation.dim() == 2:
142            observation = observation.unsqueeze(1)
143        
144        features = self.forward(observation)
145        features = features[:, -1, :]
146        
147        return self.value_head(features).squeeze(-1)

150class DecisionTransformer(BaseAgentModel):
151    """
152    Decision Transformer for offline reinforcement learning.
153    
154    Reference: Chen et al., "Decision Transformer: Reinforcement Learning via Sequence Modeling", NeurIPS 2021.
155    
156    Models trajectories as sequences of (state, action, return-to-go).
157    
158    Args:
159        config: Model configuration
160        embed_dim: Embedding dimension
161        num_heads: Number of attention heads
162        num_layers: Number of transformer layers
163        max_seq_len: Maximum sequence length
164        max_ep_len: Maximum episode length
165        dropout: Dropout probability
166    """
167    
168    def __init__(
169        self,
170        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
171        embed_dim: int = 128,
172        num_heads: int = 1,
173        num_layers: int = 3,
174        max_seq_len: int = 20,
175        max_ep_len: int = 1000,
176        dropout: float = 0.1,
177    ):
178        super().__init__(config)
179        
180        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
181        self.max_seq_len = max_seq_len
182        self.max_ep_len = max_ep_len
183        
184        # State embedding
185        self.state_embed = nn.Linear(config.input_dim, embed_dim)
186        
187        # Action embedding (for autoregressive generation)
188        self.action_embed = nn.Linear(config.action_dim, embed_dim)
189        
190        # Return-to-go embedding
191        self.rtg_embed = nn.Linear(1, embed_dim)
192        
193        # Positional embeddings
194        self.state_pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, max_ep_len, embed_dim))
195        self.action_pos_embed = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1, max_ep_len, embed_dim))
196        
197        # Transformer
198        self.transformer_blocks = nn.ModuleList([
199            TransformerBlock(embed_dim, num_heads, dropout=dropout)
200            for _ in range(num_layers)
201        ])
202        
203        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(embed_dim)
204        
205        # Action prediction head
206        self.action_head = nn.Sequential(
207            nn.Linear(embed_dim, config.action_dim),
208            nn.Tanh(),
209        )
210        
211        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
212        
213        # Initialize
214        nn.init.normal_(self.state_pos_embed, std=0.02)
215        nn.init.normal_(self.action_pos_embed, std=0.02)
216        self._init_weights()
217    
218    def _init_weights(self):
219        """Initialize weights."""
220        for module in self.modules():
221            if isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
222                nn.init.normal_(module.weight, std=0.02)
223                if module.bias is not None:
224                    nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
225            elif isinstance(module, nn.LayerNorm):
226                nn.init.ones_(module.weight)
227                nn.init.zeros_(module.bias)
228    
229    def forward(
230        self,
231        states: torch.Tensor,
232        actions: torch.Tensor,
233        returns_to_go: torch.Tensor,
234    ) -> torch.Tensor:
235        """
236        Forward pass.
237        
238        Args:
239            states: States (batch, seq_len, state_dim)
240            actions: Actions (batch, seq_len, action_dim)
241            returns_to_go: Returns to go (batch, seq_len, 1)
242        
243        Returns:
244            Predicted actions (batch, seq_len, action_dim)
245        """
246        B, T, _ = states.shape
247        
248        # Embed inputs
249        state_embeds = self.state_embed(states)
250        action_embeds = self.action_embed(actions)
251        rtg_embeds = self.rtg_embed(returns_to_go)
252        
253        # Interleave state, action, rtg embeddings
254        # [s1, a1, r1, s2, a2, r2, ...]
255        stacked = torch.stack([state_embeds, action_embeds, rtg_embeds], dim=2)
256        x = stacked.reshape(B, T * 3, self.embed_dim)
257        
258        # Add positional embeddings (repeat for each token type)
259        pos_embeds = torch.stack([
260            self.state_pos_embed[:, :T, :],
261            self.action_pos_embed[:, :T, :],
262            self.state_pos_embed[:, :T, :],  # Use state pos for rtg
263        ], dim=2).reshape(1, T * 3, self.embed_dim)
264        
265        x = x + pos_embeds
266        x = self.dropout(x)
267        
268        # Causal mask
269        mask = torch.tril(torch.ones(T * 3, T * 3, device=x.device)).view(1, 1, T * 3, T * 3)
270        
271        # Transformer
272        for block in self.transformer_blocks:
273            x = block(x, mask)
274        
275        x = self.ln(x)
276        
277        # Extract action predictions (every 3rd token starting from index 1)
278        action_preds = self.action_head(x[:, 1::3, :])
279        
280        return action_preds
281    
282    def get_action(
283        self,
284        observation: torch.Tensor,
285        returns_to_go: torch.Tensor,
286        past_actions: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
287        deterministic: bool = False,
288    ) -> torch.Tensor:
289        """
290        Get action for current timestep.
291        
292        Args:
293            observation: Current observation (batch, state_dim)
294            returns_to_go: Current return-to-go (batch, 1)
295            past_actions: Past actions in episode (batch, past_len, action_dim)
296            deterministic: Whether to use deterministic action
297        
298        Returns:
299            Action (batch, action_dim)
300        """
301        B = observation.shape[0]
302        
303        # Prepare sequence
304        if past_actions is None:
305            # First timestep
306            states = observation.unsqueeze(1)
307            actions = torch.zeros(B, 1, self.config.action_dim, device=observation.device)
308            rtgs = returns_to_go.unsqueeze(1)
309        else:
310            # Use past trajectory
311            T = past_actions.shape[1] + 1
312            states = torch.cat([
313                torch.zeros(B, T - 1, self.config.input_dim, device=observation.device),
314                observation.unsqueeze(1),
315            ], dim=1)
316            actions = torch.cat([
317                past_actions,
318                torch.zeros(B, 1, self.config.action_dim, device=observation.device),
319            ], dim=1)
320            rtgs = returns_to_go.unsqueeze(1).repeat(1, T, 1)
321        
322        # Get action predictions
323        action_preds = self.forward(states, actions, rtgs)
324        
325        # Get last action prediction
326        action = action_preds[:, -1, :]
327        
328        if deterministic:
329            return action
330        else:
331            # Add small noise for exploration
332            noise = torch.randn_like(action) * 0.1
333            return action + noise
334    
335    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
336        """Not directly implemented for Decision Transformer."""
337        # Could estimate value from returns_to_go
338        raise NotImplementedError("Use returns_to_go for value estimation")

class PerceiverAgent(torchagentic.BaseAgentModel): 
 88class PerceiverAgent(BaseAgentModel):
 89    """
 90    Perceiver-based agent for handling large or multimodal inputs.
 91    
 92    Uses a bottleneck of latent variables to process inputs efficiently.
 93    
 94    Args:
 95        config: Model configuration
 96        embed_dim: Embedding dimension
 97        num_latents: Number of latent variables
 98        num_heads: Number of attention heads
 99        num_layers: Number of transformer layers
100        dropout: Dropout probability
101    """
102    
103    def __init__(
104        self,
105        config: Optional[ModelConfig] = None,
106        embed_dim: int = 256,
107        num_latents: int = 64,
108        num_heads: int = 8,
109        num_layers: int = 4,
110        dropout: float = 0.1,
111    ):
112        super().__init__(config)
113        
114        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
115        
116        # Perceiver encoder
117        self.encoder = PerceiverResampler(
118            input_dim=config.input_dim,
119            embed_dim=embed_dim,
120            num_latents=num_latents,
121            num_heads=num_heads,
122            num_layers=num_layers,
123            dropout=dropout,
124        )
125        
126        # Action decoder
127        self.action_decoder = nn.Sequential(
128            nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim),
129            nn.GELU(),
130            nn.Linear(embed_dim, config.action_dim),
131        )
132        
133        # Value decoder
134        self.value_decoder = nn.Sequential(
135            nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim),
136            nn.GELU(),
137            nn.Linear(embed_dim, 1),
138        )
139        
140        self.dropout = dropout
141    
142    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
143        """
144        Forward pass.
145        
146        Args:
147            x: Input tensor (batch, seq_len, input_dim)
148        
149        Returns:
150            Latent representation (batch, num_latents, embed_dim)
151        """
152        return self.encoder(x)
153    
154    def get_action(
155        self,
156        observation: torch.Tensor,
157        deterministic: bool = False,
158    ) -> torch.Tensor:
159        """Get action."""
160        # Ensure 3D
161        if observation.dim() == 2:
162            observation = observation.unsqueeze(1)
163        
164        # Encode
165        latents = self.forward(observation)
166        
167        # Pool latents
168        pooled = latents.mean(dim=1)
169        
170        # Decode action
171        logits = self.action_decoder(pooled)
172        
173        if deterministic:
174            return torch.argmax(logits, dim=-1)
175        else:
176            dist = torch.distributions.Categorical(logits=logits)
177            return dist.sample()
178    
179    def get_value(self, observation: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
180        """Get value estimate."""
181        if observation.dim() == 2:
182            observation = observation.unsqueeze(1)
183        
184        latents = self.forward(observation)
185        pooled = latents.mean(dim=1)
186        
187        return self.value_decoder(pooled).squeeze(-1)

class SelfAttention(torch.nn.modules.module.Module): 
13class SelfAttention(nn.Module):
14    """
15    Self-attention mechanism.
16    
17    Args:
18        embed_dim: Embedding dimension
19        num_heads: Number of attention heads
20        dropout: Dropout probability
21        bias: Whether to use bias in linear layers
22    """
23    
24    def __init__(
25        self,
26        embed_dim: int,
27        num_heads: int = 8,
28        dropout: float = 0.0,
29        bias: bool = True,
30    ):
31        super().__init__()
32        
33        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
34        self.num_heads = num_heads
35        self.head_dim = embed_dim // num_heads
36        
37        assert embed_dim % num_heads == 0, "embed_dim must be divisible by num_heads"
38        
39        self.scale = self.head_dim ** -0.5
40        
41        self.qkv = nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim * 3, bias=bias)
42        self.proj = nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim, bias=bias)
43        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
44    
45    def forward(
46        self,
47        x: torch.Tensor,
48        mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
49    ) -> torch.Tensor:
50        """
51        Forward pass.
52        
53        Args:
54            x: Input tensor (batch, seq_len, embed_dim)
55            mask: Optional attention mask
56        
57        Returns:
58            Output tensor (batch, seq_len, embed_dim)
59        """
60        B, T, C = x.shape
61        
62        # Compute Q, K, V
63        q, k, v = self.qkv(x).chunk(3, dim=-1)
64        
65        # Reshape for multi-head attention
66        q = q.view(B, T, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
67        k = k.view(B, T, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
68        v = v.view(B, T, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
69        
70        # Attention scores
71        scores = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1) * self.scale
72        
73        if mask is not None:
74            scores = scores.masked_fill(mask == 0, float("-inf"))
75        
76        # Softmax and dropout
77        attn = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
78        attn = self.dropout(attn)
79        
80        # Apply attention to values
81        out = attn @ v
82        
83        # Reshape back
84        out = out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, T, C)
85        
86        return self.proj(out)

46        self,
47        x: torch.Tensor,
48        mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
49    ) -> torch.Tensor:
50        """
51        Forward pass.
52        
53        Args:
54            x: Input tensor (batch, seq_len, embed_dim)
55            mask: Optional attention mask
56        
57        Returns:
58            Output tensor (batch, seq_len, embed_dim)
59        """
60        B, T, C = x.shape
61        
62        # Compute Q, K, V
63        q, k, v = self.qkv(x).chunk(3, dim=-1)
64        
65        # Reshape for multi-head attention
66        q = q.view(B, T, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
67        k = k.view(B, T, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
68        v = v.view(B, T, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
69        
70        # Attention scores
71        scores = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1) * self.scale
72        
73        if mask is not None:
74            scores = scores.masked_fill(mask == 0, float("-inf"))
75        
76        # Softmax and dropout
77        attn = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
78        attn = self.dropout(attn)
79        
80        # Apply attention to values
81        out = attn @ v
82        
83        # Reshape back
84        out = out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, T, C)
85        
86        return self.proj(out)

Forward pass.

Args: x: Input tensor (batch, seq_len, embed_dim) mask: Optional attention mask

Returns: Output tensor (batch, seq_len, embed_dim)

 89class MultiHeadAttention(nn.Module):
 90    """
 91    Multi-head attention with separate Q, K, V projections.
 92    
 93    Supports cross-attention between different sequences.
 94    """
 95    
 96    def __init__(
 97        self,
 98        embed_dim: int,
 99        num_heads: int = 8,
100        dropout: float = 0.0,
101        bias: bool = True,
102    ):
103        super().__init__()
104        
105        self.embed_dim = embed_dim
106        self.num_heads = num_heads
107        self.head_dim = embed_dim // num_heads
108        
109        assert embed_dim % num_heads == 0
110        
111        self.scale = self.head_dim ** -0.5
112        
113        self.query = nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim, bias=bias)
114        self.key = nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim, bias=bias)
115        self.value = nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim, bias=bias)
116        self.proj = nn.Linear(embed_dim, embed_dim, bias=bias)
117        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
118    
119    def forward(
120        self,
121        query: torch.Tensor,
122        key: torch.Tensor,
123        value: torch.Tensor,
124        mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
125    ) -> torch.Tensor:
126        """
127        Forward pass.
128        
129        Args:
130            query: Query tensor (batch, seq_len_q, embed_dim)
131            key: Key tensor (batch, seq_len_k, embed_dim)
132            value: Value tensor (batch, seq_len_k, embed_dim)
133            mask: Optional attention mask
134        
135        Returns:
136            Output tensor (batch, seq_len_q, embed_dim)
137        """
138        B, T_q, C = query.shape
139        T_k = key.shape[1]
140        
141        # Project Q, K, V
142        q = self.query(query).view(B, T_q, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
143        k = self.key(key).view(B, T_k, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
144        v = self.value(value).view(B, T_k, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
145        
146        # Attention scores
147        scores = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1) * self.scale
148        
149        if mask is not None:
150            scores = scores.masked_fill(mask == 0, float("-inf"))
151        
152        # Softmax and dropout
153        attn = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
154        attn = self.dropout(attn)
155        
156        # Apply attention to values
157        out = attn @ v
158        
159        # Reshape back
160        out = out.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, T_q, C)
161        
162        return self.proj(out)
